blocks.text: Watering in the evening loses less to the sun than the morning does, in week 24 of the plan.
The long run moves to Saturday so Sunday can be a rest day, in week 24 of the plan.
We will cache the search results for an hour and nobody will notice, in week 24 of the plan.
Reading twenty pages a night gets me through a book a fortnight, in week 24 of the plan.
The tomatoes go in the bed by the fence, where it is warmest, in week 24 of the plan.
Interval sessions at 4:40 per km build the speed for race day, in week 24 of the plan.
